findings.detail: Exact Q architecture/optimizer/LR/minibatch/grad-clip/storage,actor runtime config,LR progress numerator,legacy-GAE comparator,worker topology and deal/mirror/all-in-EV settings are not fully selected by the preregistration.

The fresh per-hand six-model selector changes opponent temporal correlation and model-request batching from the per-iteration single-opponent topology that produced the frozen104.447 admitted-pure HPS bound. The942s headroom is not transferable and the external contrast confounds Qboost with opponent scheduling.
Per-hand reassignment is incompatible with inherited mirrored self-play:forcing a self-play mirror violates the selector law;rehashing the mirror breaks mirrored-pair semantics.

No global order across22 pipes,enqueue serial,atomic hand-start generation/assignment snapshot,raw-before-admission rule or split-batch handling is frozen. The allowed inherited worker cannot satisfy the required packet contract unchanged.

Invocation,stdout,stderr,result,raw packet,assignment,surplus,metrics,trace,checkpoint,endpoint and audit paths/schemas plus timeout race,pipe drain,descendant grace/termination and exit classification are not exact.

judgment: Freeze VR004 permanently;never implement,repair,rerun or reclassify it. This is not a Qboost scientific failure.
required_rerank: The repeated attempt to compress a complex behavior window into thin inheritance is itself the root workflow failure. Before any further behavior preregistration,the goal must be redesigned around one content-addressed executable experiment package with one topology,one packet protocol,one supervisor/evidence graph and one independent verifier,rather than successive overlay identities.
route_effect: All four families remain scientifically open;no valid behavior or external result was produced;route exhaustion false.
